issues.quote: How I used to wait for them at times!
I would shudder when I heard a human shadow behind me
would that hand unclench its iron fingers, or would it release me?

strengths.quote: I have grown sick of being a coaching inn where those creatures forever jostle, shout, bustle about and foul the place.
the roaring torrents of human life rushing toward me like wild horses from all the city streets
would the iron hand clatter its bones in vain?
petty, unnecessary words, like chips and straw on spring torrents
